policy: Planning and mechanical readiness only. No milestone status here upgrades original native evidence, SPEC maturity, RR dispatch, or authorizes runtime Client execution.

milestones.name: Gateway framing/connection handshake contract
acceptance: Identify direction-specific wire framing and first application message for the relevant connection (not only local buffer assembly).
Bind slot, pipeline, mode, handoff state and failure path to source-target versions; no unproven listen-port requirements.
Add source-backed positive and boundary/error conformance vectors without implying native malformed-packet policy from a conservative tool.
milestones.handoff_to: Protocol Gateway implementer after reviewed scoped contract

milestones.name: Login result and server-selection handoff contract
acceptance: Specify C2S E8/000F chosen path and S2C login-result consumer including actual command, byte bounds, status and failure branch.
Bound exact channel/choice and connection handoff order; keep official Server account policy distinct from locally chosen ADR.
Provide a bidirectional request/reply example with exact provenance or mark the specific indispensable fields as blocked.
milestones.handoff_to: Session and Login service implementer after reviewed contract

milestones.name: Character roster, selection response and initialization loop
acceptance: Separate S2C command2 65+53N roster from unrelated 2-byte-prefixed consumer; validate header semantics and ID allocation constraints.
Pair C2S selection 0x42 with the actual S2C success/error handler and subsequent initialization request/responses; no request+1 guessing.
Record Session/character state transitions and resource/UI prerequisites in reproducible message order.
Gate E05: prove reachable zero-roster/create-button UI entry, event and resource prerequisites; never equate command2 parse with visible creation UI.
Gate E06: identify separate create-character C2S and matching S2C result/roster initialization with versioned bounded proof; do not reuse select 0x42 or fabricate reply fields.
milestones.handoff_to: Character and roster service implementer after reviewed contract

milestones.name: Selected character to field/tutorial scene dependency
acceptance: Identify the exact S2C or local Client state writer that gates scene transitions after successful selection, with native control flow provenance.
Keep Event/SceneList (1001,1)->tutorial_start static index distinct from any S2C packet; account for 0x565720 reuse after EndCutScene.
If selection-to-scene remains unknown, mark this milestone blocked and do not invent tutorial/session start payload.
milestones.handoff_to: World/scene service only when selection-dependent wire state is demonstrated

milestones.name: Independent spec-only implementation handoff
acceptance: Provide a new implementer only spec/ and conformance/ plus published ADRs, not raw reverse engineering source; record every necessary ambiguity encountered.
Demonstrate at least one direction-specific request/reply contract independently understood from SPEC and linked tests; no unsupported wire values.
Review evidence provenance, errors, and known Client-version limits before Phase B is described as a completed bounded deliverable.

milestones.name: Independent Server environment and compatibility feedback
acceptance: Define isolated test instance, data authority and Session ownership in independent Server repo using clearly labeled Server ADRs.
Return non-sensitive, reproducible feedback with Client version, exact spec revision, test input/result and mismatch classification.
Only perform original Client runtime compatibility testing after explicit authorization and appropriate environment; never equate static unit tests with original Client success.
